Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task’s criterion by checking whether members had ever held C-suite roles rather than whether they held C-suite positions at the time they joined Apple’s board. This led to the incorrect conclusion that none fit the criterion, overlooking cases like Susan L. Wagner (retired from COO/vice chair roles by 2012 before joining Apple’s board in 2014) and likely Ronald D. Sugar (retired from CEO role in 2010 around his board appointment).
